name: Will Kabat-Zinn
reason: No published email and no contact form anywhere we could find: his site sundaysangha.net has only a mailing-list sign-up, donation links and a WordPress subscribe box (the 'Contact Form' text the quick scan saw is a script string, not a form), and his Spirit Rock, Omega and Esalen profiles give no way to reach him; otherwise a strong Insight Meditation teacher (Spirit Rock teachers council, YouTube channel, Omega retreat 18–23 Jul 2027), so worth revisiting if a contact route appears.
